edge_feasibility_assessment.raspberry_pi_4_5: FEASIBLE: At ~1.1M parameters and ~4ms forward pass, Raspberry Pi 4/5 (Quad-core Cortex-A72/A76) will easily achieve RTF < 0.15.
edge_feasibility_assessment.jetson_nano: FEASIBLE: GPU-accelerated TensorRT will execute well under 2ms per window.
edge_feasibility_assessment.esp32_microcontroller: INCOMPATIBLE: ESP32 has 520 KB SRAM and operates at 240 MHz. A 1.1M parameter float32 model requires >4.4 MB RAM, exceeding on-chip memory. An edge gateway (e.g. Raspberry Pi Zero 2W or ARM Cortex-M55 with external PSRAM) is required.
